note.text: Root-flake trust-boundary clarification: the existing repository flake is the single canonical definition for the devshell, MicroVM guest, trusted launcher packages, host integration module, and checks; no nested flake will be introduced. Live agent-writable checkout code must be evaluated only inside the guest. Trusted host installation or update may evaluate the root flake only from an immutable, explicitly reviewed, exact Git revision, producing an installed Nix-store closure. Routine vm-codex and vm-shell launches must execute that installed closure, accept the checkout and validated configuration only as data, invoke no Nix, and never evaluate the live checkout. This clarification supersedes any broader wording that could be read as forbidding immutable exact-revision evaluation during trusted installation.
